source: ACC01 v2.0, 2026-01-08, hierarchy tables on PDF pages 25-34

BS/NA/PPE/LAND.name: Operational land
BS/NA/PPE/LAND.exclusions: Exclude investment land and land held for resale.

BS/NA/PPE/MTVE.name: Motor vehicles
BS/NA/PPE/MTVE.exclusions: Exclude fuel, rental and vehicles for resale.

BS/NA/PPE/COMP.name: Computers
BS/NA/PPE/COMP.definition: Computer hardware held for business use
BS/NA/PPE/COMP.exclusions: Exclude hardware bought for resale and subscriptions.

BS/NA/PPE/SOFT.name: Software assets
BS/NA/PPE/SOFT.definition: Software meeting the company asset recognition policy
BS/NA/PPE/SOFT.exclusions: Exclude recurring SaaS access and support; capitalisation requires review.

BS/NA/IVM/ILND.name: Investment land
BS/NA/IVM/ILND.definition: Land held for investment rather than operational use
BS/NA/IVM/ILND.exclusions: Exclude operational land and developer trading stock.

BS/NA/IVM/IBDG.name: Investment buildings
BS/NA/IVM/IBDG.definition: Property held for rental income or appreciation
BS/NA/IVM/IBDG.exclusions: Exclude owner-occupied buildings and property trading stock.

BS/CA/IVT/TSTK.name: Trading stock
BS/CA/IVT/TSTK.definition: Goods held for resale in ordinary business
BS/CA/IVT/TSTK.exclusions: Exclude office equipment used by the company.

BS/CA/IVT/CSTK.name: Consumable stock
BS/CA/IVT/CSTK.definition: Materials and supplies held for operational consumption
BS/CA/IVT/CSTK.exclusions: Exclude already consumed expenses; follow inventory policy.

BS/CA/TRV/TRDB.name: Trade debtors
BS/CA/TRV/TRDB.definition: Customer amounts due from ordinary credit sales
BS/CA/TRV/TRDB.exclusions: Exclude supplier advances and customer deposits received.

BS/CA/TRV/TRDP.name: Supplier advances and trade deposits paid
BS/CA/TRV/TRDP.definition: Trade deposits paid to suppliers for future purchases
BS/CA/TRV/TRDP.exclusions: Exclude unpaid supplier balances and customer advances received; PDF label is ambiguous, use payment direction.

BS/CA/ORV/OTDP.name: Refundable non-trade deposits paid
BS/CA/ORV/OTDP.definition: Refundable security deposits paid by the company
BS/CA/ORV/OTDP.exclusions: Exclude deposits received; PDF wording conflicts with asset classification, require review.

BS/CA/ORV/PRMT.name: Prepayments
BS/CA/ORV/PRMT.definition: Advance payments for future goods or service coverage
usage_examples: Annual insurance paid before coverage is consumed
BS/CA/ORV/PRMT.exclusions: Exclude refundable security deposits and already consumed services; a billing period alone does not prove prepayment.

BS/CA/ORV/DIRA.name: Director receivables
BS/CA/ORV/DIRA.definition: Non-trade amounts owed to the company by directors
BS/CA/ORV/DIRA.exclusions: Amounts owed to directors use OPDC instead.

BS/CA/CTX/CYTX.name: Current-year tax paid
BS/CA/CTX/CYTX.definition: Current-year income tax payments recoverable or offset against tax liability
BS/CA/CTX/CYTX.exclusions: Not supplier SST input tax; distinguish tax expense and tax payable.

BS/CA/CTX/PYPX.name: Prior-year tax overpaid
BS/CA/CTX/PYPX.definition: Recoverable overpayment of prior-year income tax

BS/CA/CNB/BANK.name: Cash at bank
BS/CA/CNB/BANK.definition: Balances and movements in company bank accounts
BS/CA/CNB/BANK.exclusions: Exclude overdraft liabilities; do not assume payment from invoice bank details.

BS/CA/CNB/CASH.name: Cash on hand
BS/CA/CNB/CASH.definition: Physical cash held by the business

BS/EQ/CAP/POCP.name: Proprietor capital
BS/EQ/CAP/POCP.exclusions: Exclude owner loans where separately accounted.

BS/EQ/CPR/SHPM.name: Share premium
BS/EQ/CPR/SHPM.definition: Share premium where applicable under entity policy
BS/EQ/CPR/SHPM.exclusions: Do not infer premium from ordinary cash receipts; require review.

BS/EQ/CPR/RVSP.name: Revaluation surplus
BS/EQ/CPR/RVSP.exclusions: Exclude sale proceeds and ordinary revenue.

BS/EQ/RVR/APNL.name: Accumulated profit and loss
BS/EQ/RVR/APNL.exclusions: Exclude ordinary invoice revenue or expenses.

BS/NL/NBR/NCTL.name: Long-term bank loans
BS/NL/NBR/NCTL.definition: Bank borrowing payable beyond twelve months

BS/NL/NFL/NCFL.name: Long-term finance lease liability
BS/NL/NFL/NCFL.exclusions: Exclude lease interest; apply approved lease policy.

BS/NL/DTX/NCDX.name: Deferred tax liabilities
BS/NL/DTX/NCDX.definition: Future tax obligations from temporary differences
BS/NL/DTX/NCDX.exclusions: Exclude current income tax payable; require review.

BS/CL/TPY/TPTC.name: Trade creditors
BS/CL/TPY/TPTC.definition: Supplier balances due for ordinary credit purchases
BS/CL/TPY/TPTC.exclusions: Exclude customer advances and non-trade creditors.

BS/CL/TPY/TPTD.name: Customer advances and trade deposits received
BS/CL/TPY/TPTD.definition: Deposits received against future customer orders
BS/CL/TPY/TPTD.exclusions: Exclude supplier deposits paid; not earned revenue automatically.

BS/CL/OPY/OPCR.name: Other creditors
usage_examples: Non-trade amount owed to third party
BS/CL/OPY/OPCR.exclusions: Exclude ordinary trade suppliers and accrued uninvoiced expenses.

BS/CL/OPY/OPDC.name: Director creditors
BS/CL/OPY/OPDC.exclusions: Exclude director receivables and equity contributions.

BS/CL/OPY/OPCC.name: Accruals
BS/CL/OPY/OPCC.definition: Expenses incurred but not yet paid or invoiced at reporting date
usage_examples: Unbilled electricity consumed at month end
BS/CL/OPY/OPCC.exclusions: Exclude future service prepayments and already booked invoices.

BS/CL/SFL/STFL.name: Current finance lease liability
BS/CL/SFL/STFL.definition: Lease principal due within twelve months

BS/CL/CTL/CRTX.name: Current income tax payable
BS/CL/CTL/CRTX.exclusions: Use SNTP for sales and service tax, not income tax.

BS/CL/CTL/STDF.name: Service tax deferred
BS/CL/CTL/STDF.definition: Deferred service tax balance under applicable policy
BS/CL/CTL/STDF.exclusions: Do not infer tax timing or rates; require review.

BS/CL/CTL/SNTP.name: Sales and service tax payable
BS/CL/CTL/SNTP.definition: Explicit sales and service tax owed to authorities
BS/CL/CTL/SNTP.exclusions: Exclude income tax and tax charged by suppliers as an automatically recoverable asset.

BS/CL/SBR/OVDF.name: Bank overdraft
BS/CL/SBR/OVDF.exclusions: Exclude ordinary positive bank balance and overdraft interest.

PL/TI/TIN/SLIC.name: Sales income
PL/TI/TIN/SLIC.definition: Earned operating revenue from goods sold
PL/TI/TIN/SLIC.exclusions: Exclude customer advance before goods are delivered.

PL/TI/TIN/SVIC.name: Service income
PL/TI/TIN/SVIC.definition: Earned operating revenue from services supplied
PL/TI/TIN/SVIC.exclusions: Exclude unearned advance for future services.

PL/TE/TEX/CSSL.name: Cost of sales
PL/TE/TEX/CSSL.definition: Direct costs attributable to goods or services sold
PL/TE/TEX/CSSL.exclusions: Exclude unsold inventory and general administrative costs.

PL/TE/TEX/DTEX.name: Distribution expenses
PL/TE/TEX/DTEX.definition: Storage, handling and delivery costs for customers
PL/TE/TEX/DTEX.exclusions: Distinguish inventory acquisition costs and marketing.

PL/TE/TEX/MKEX.name: Marketing expenses
PL/TE/TEX/MKEX.exclusions: Exclude equipment assets and refundable campaign deposits.

PL/TE/TEX/OPEX.name: Other operating expenses
PL/TE/TEX/OPEX.definition: Other costs of primary business operations
PL/TE/TEX/OPEX.exclusions: Exclude administration, finance, inventory, assets and unconsumed prepaid coverage.

PL/OI/OIN/DBMT.name: Disbursement income
PL/OI/OIN/DBMT.definition: Disbursement recoveries when policy recognises income
PL/OI/OIN/DBMT.exclusions: May be clearing a receivable rather than income; require evidence and review.

PL/OI/OIN/RBMT.name: Reimbursement income
PL/OI/OIN/RBMT.definition: Reimbursement of prior costs when income treatment applies
PL/OI/OIN/RBMT.exclusions: May offset expense or receivable; do not recognise income automatically.

PL/OI/OIN/OVTC.name: Overdue interest income
PL/OI/OIN/OVTC.definition: Interest earned on late customer payments

PL/OI/OIN/BINC.name: Bank interest income
PL/OI/OIN/BINC.exclusions: Exclude interest paid and loan principal.

PL/OI/OIN/RBDR.name: Rebates and discounts received
PL/OI/OIN/RBDR.definition: Supplier rebates where income classification applies
PL/OI/OIN/RBDR.exclusions: May reduce inventory or purchase cost; follow company policy.

PL/OI/OIN/GPME.name: Gain on asset disposal
PL/OI/OIN/GPME.definition: Gain above carrying value on fixed asset disposal
PL/OI/OIN/GPME.exclusions: Sale proceeds alone are insufficient; carrying value is needed.

PL/OI/OIN/RTNC.name: Rental income
PL/OI/OIN/RTNC.definition: Incidental rental income outside primary operations
PL/OI/OIN/RTNC.exclusions: Primary rental business may need operating service income; assess MSIC and actual use.

PL/OI/OIN/ISCL.name: Insurance claims
PL/OI/OIN/ISCL.exclusions: Exclude insurance premiums and prepaid insurance.

PL/OI/OIN/OTNC.name: Other income
PL/OI/OIN/OTNC.definition: Incidental income not fitting specific categories
PL/OI/OIN/OTNC.exclusions: Prefer specific category where evidence supports it.

PL/OE/OEX/DPRC.name: Depreciation
PL/OE/OEX/DPRC.definition: Allocation of capital asset cost over useful life
PL/OE/OEX/DPRC.exclusions: Exclude initial asset purchase and tax capital allowances.

PL/OE/OEX/GNEX.name: General and administrative expenses
PL/OE/OEX/GNEX.exclusions: Exclude future prepaid coverage, capital assets and direct cost of sales.

PL/FE/FEX/OVNT.name: Overdraft interest
PL/FE/FEX/OVNT.exclusions: Exclude principal and ordinary bank service fees.

PL/FE/FEX/FLNT.name: Finance lease interest
PL/FE/FEX/FLNT.definition: Interest component of finance lease payment

PL/FE/FEX/TLNT.name: Term loan interest
PL/FE/FEX/TLNT.exclusions: Exclude principal and qualifying capitalised borrowing costs.

PL/FE/FEX/OTNT.name: Other interest expense
PL/FE/FEX/OTNT.definition: Other financing interest not classified above
PL/FE/FEX/OTNT.exclusions: Exclude non-interest bank charges; PDF examples conflict, use nature of charge.

PL/TX/ITX/TCYX.name: Current-year income tax expense
PL/TX/ITX/TCYX.definition: Income tax expense on current-year profits
PL/TX/ITX/TCYX.exclusions: Exclude tax instalment assets and SST.

PL/TX/ITX/TXPL.name: Tax penalties
PL/TX/ITX/TXPL.exclusions: Exclude ordinary tax principal; do not infer deductibility.

PL/TX/ITX/TDTX.name: Deferred tax expense
PL/TX/ITX/TDTX.exclusions: Exclude current tax payment; requires review.

PL/TX/RPX/PRGX.name: Property gains tax
PL/TX/RPX/PRGX.definition: Tax expense on taxable property disposal
PL/TX/RPX/PRGX.exclusions: Exclude disposal proceeds and other income tax.

PL/TX/RPX/CPGX.name: Capital gains tax
PL/TX/RPX/CPGX.definition: Tax expense on relevant capital asset gains
PL/TX/RPX/CPGX.exclusions: Do not infer tax liability from sale alone.

PL/TX/OTX/OTEX.name: Other tax expenses
PL/TX/OTX/OTEX.definition: Other tax costs not classified above
